cornerReview.scope: Conservative synthetic aperture only; not measured panel mask

calendarBridge.qualification: Native previews are synthetic; installation does not establish timing or endurance qualification.

subdialAlignment.note: Main center retained at (205,251); main-circle margins are not exactly equal.

presentationPolicy.localHold: Display only, less than 24h from valid anchor; withdraw source, lock, RMS and sampled hold. Never feeds timing/admission.
presentationPolicy.gesture: Resolve on release: horizontal displacement >=64px and >2x vertical displacement within 1.5s; tap displacement <20px on each axis. Left advances Digital → Instrument → Solar → Shadow → Digital; right reverses, modulo four. Selection persists. Wake consumes the entire gesture.
presentationPolicy.receiver: Calendar bridge: independent source drum and RX apertures flank a concentric PLL phase well. Source shows BLE for BLE/RC1/RC2, LOR, distinct RC9, HOLD during valid hold, or --- without time. Full/half/dark phase means lock/hold/acquisition or unavailable. RX jewel reports powered receiver independently of source selection and packet freshness. No source selector ring or triangle.
presentationPolicy.rms: Linear 0ns–10us, 2.5us divisions; OVER above 10000ns, unavailable red parking outside sweep.

solar.zone: Central CST/CDT, independent of mesh display zone
solar.sky: Fixed civil 24-hour scale. Actual morning/evening sunrise/sunset and three twilight chords set seasonal horizon height/tilt; eight crossing ticks/dots use each event’s own Central offset, including DST-change dates. Calculated lunar phase graphic without percentage caption; illustrative stars.
solar.rms: Linear 0–10us; ns/us labels; >10 us above range.
solar.p99: Integer s/ms/us, no >= prefix; sampled 1–60s ring; bounds retained as diagnostic metadata.
solar.source: Identifier-only text. Actual RSSI drives ring clamped [-110,-40]dBm; no numeric RSSI or percentage text. Missing strength dims ring.
solar.tide: TIDE ~ approximate predicted event interpolation, low=0/high=1; RISE/FALL; unavailable ring dim with active endpoint removed, EXP at expiry and -- otherwise.
solar.hold: HOLD withdraws live source/precision; estimated sky never grants timing authority.
solar.clock: Pale-rimmed 83px-radius medallion moves opposite the sun according to current Central civil time on 35px internal circle, carrying Central date/time and lunar graphic; no SOLAR or lunar-percentage copy. Seasonal changes do not add clock displacement. Acquisition <=12px/s; unknown astronomy retains position.

shadow.power: GNSS main power requested only while Shadow is awake and visible; leaving the face, opening an app, display sleep or maintenance removes the request. Backup power is preserved.
shadow.observer: RX-only GNSS observer; no receiver configuration/aid, mesh admission, servo training or clock authority. Solar location remains fixed.
shadow.sky: Plot only actual azimuth/elevation with position_known; unknown position suppresses its dot, while C/N0 can remain independently available.
shadow.sourceGate: Current selected fresh BLE/RC1/RC2 only; LoRa, RC9, local HOLD, expiry or stale presentation suppress retained BLE statistics and show waiting.
shadow.settling: Ten phase-blind seconds before collection; source/scope or reference changes, PPS gaps and new visits reset the population. No phase trimming or outlier removal.
shadow.metrics: Signed MEAN and P99 ABS with coarse tails marked ~; smaller RMS/N; ns/us/ms and -- for missing evidence. Other-face P99 retains sampled-hold meaning.
shadow.reference: Independent GNSS fix and recent captured PPS required; physical pulse is independent of mesh seconds and acquisition sweep.
shadow.qualification: Native preview approval, source/build checks and finish review establish source/render quality only; installed behavior, receiver bias, absolute UTC, independent precision and power remain unqualified.

material.rings: Directional metal-shadow to metal-highlight interpolation; upper-left raised highlights, reversed for recesses.
material.wells: Vertical well-top to well-bottom blend, well-groove circles every 4px.
material.dial: Radial/directional blend from dial-highlight to instrument-dial; RGB565 interpolation.
material.digital: Retains flat tonal fields and chamfer frames.
material.shadow: Flat graphite fields, paired chamfer outlines, quiet rules and narrow lime accents; no gradients, material shadows or photographic texture. Dedicated palette does not replace incumbent faces.

instrumentStaticLayer.initialization: Build once at first presentation, including when Digital is selected.
instrumentStaticLayer.redraw: Copy the static Instrument layer, then draw source text, phase, RX contents, precision pointers and moving hands. Engravings, aperture frames and well geometry remain cached.
instrumentStaticLayer.visualContract: Preserve the reviewed pixels; cached and uncached fixture images match pixel-for-pixel. No hardware timing, power or precision qualification follows from this comparison.
instrumentStaticLayer.allocationFallback: If allocation fails, draw the same static base directly for each Instrument frame.

solarLayer.ephemeris: UI worker caches per UTC minute
solarLayer.rebuild: Sampled UTC minute or astronomy known-state changes
solarLayer.damage: Generation-aware 32px tiles restore old/new dynamic regions; face, framebuffer or backdrop generation change requires full restore.
solarLayer.qualification: Synthetic cache equivalence is not installed-device performance or timing qualification.
solarLayer.skyConstruction: Cache four chord column-height arrays and a 256-entry daylight palette per backdrop rebuild; no per-pixel pow/trigonometry in sky bands.

shadow.technique: Native RGB565 full-frame geometry with the existing bundled Rajdhani atlas; no new runtime font or raster artwork.
shadow.authority: Native C++ renderer and current source/reference gates are authoritative; panel swatches are schematic only.

narrative.overview:
Digital retains the Casio-inspired dark segmented display, pale phosphor time and amber controls within a chamfered bezel and inset LCD frame. Instrument translates the approved olive perpetual-calendar reference into original PToB mechanical indicators inside a squarish instrument case, with pale lume and restrained red needles. Directional bevels, grooved recessed wells and broad outlined pilot hands give Instrument physical depth. Neither face copies a brand mark.

This visual authority applies only to firmware/twatch. The native C++ framebuffer is authoritative; sidecar swatches illustrate components. Host captures and offline finish reviews establish source/render quality only. The operator has confirmed physical rendering of the earlier Digital face; Instrument appearance on hardware, optical timing, precision and power remain unqualified.

Solar adds the approved solarpath.webp daily orbit: calculated Santa Rosa Beach/Central sun, twilight and lunar phase, original native geometry and four compact circular corner subdials and a pale-rimmed clock moving opposite the sun. Its scope is this third face; Digital and Instrument retain their established visual systems. Synthetic previews do not establish hardware acceptance.

Shadow adds the user-pinned Casio/Garmin instrument direction as a fourth world: graphite, pale segmented time, lime activity and blue-grey diagnostic labels. Each face uses original PToB artwork without brand marks and preserves the other faces' established visual systems. Native preview approval and finish review do not establish installed GNSS behavior, independent precision or power acceptance.
keyCharacteristics: Time-first segmented Digital, mechanical Instrument, daily-orbit Solar or GNSS-comparison Shadow display.
Chamfered case geometry and inset readable content.
Face-specific palette with shared utility screens and controls.
Explicit unavailable evidence and display-only local hold.

rules.name: Display-only hold
rules.body: Display only, less than 24h from valid anchor; withdraw source, lock, RMS and sampled hold. Never feeds timing/admission.

rules.name: Printed bounds
rules.body: Keep linear 0ns–10us RMS and OVER above range, <=1/>=60 hold endpoints, lower-bound-only hold evidence parked as unavailable, red unavailable parking and NO TIME aperture distinct.

rules.name: Receiver identity
rules.body: Calendar bridge: independent source drum and RX apertures flank a concentric PLL phase well. Source shows BLE for BLE/RC1/RC2, LOR, distinct RC9, HOLD during valid hold, or --- without time. Full/half/dark phase means lock/hold/acquisition or unavailable. RX jewel reports powered receiver independently of source selection and packet freshness. No source selector ring or triangle.

dos: Do keep this visual authority scoped to firmware/twatch.
Do use the bundled Rajdhani atlas and original segment geometry.
Do preserve units, unavailable states and explicit status labels.

Do review all four faces and all utility screens at native resolution, with the rounded aperture and unavailable, local-hold, overflow, RC9 and lower-bound states, plus release-resolved swipe and wake gestures.
Do preserve Shadow's actual satellite-position gating, physical PPS pulse and fresh selected-source measurement gate.
donts: Don't use synthetic preview values as hardware evidence.
Don't convey lock, selection, saturation or failure through color alone.
Don't treat display-only local hold as current timing authority or retain precision during it.
Don't add web hover or responsive behavior to the native touchscreen contract.
Don't introduce image assets for elements already drawn by the renderer.
